results: The actual inverse-square-root source denominator, normalized by the ORIGINAL H1 weight, is a bounded symbol on the ENTIRE literal source circle, with norm at most 4*sqrt(n). Actual bounded inverse maps are CONSTRUCTED in both directions. All FOUR inverse identities and all raw original distribution coefficients are proved; the native half-map operator norms are at most 4*sqrt(n). No smooth core or finite-mode replacement is used.

The actual source normalized free phase I_lambda(k)=(lambda-pi^2*k^2)/|lambda-pi^2*k^2| and its inverse are bounded complex l2 operators of norm at most ONE. Their LEFT and RIGHT inverse identities are proved on the ENTIRE Hilbert space on each original source circle.

The ACTUAL total normalized inverse (I_lambda-S_lambda)^(-1) is identified as a genuine two-sided inverse with operator norm at most TWO whenever the ACTUAL previously constructed perturbation norm is at most ONE HALF. Its exact ordered difference from I_lambda^(-1) is inverse*(S_lambda*I_lambda^(-1)), with norm at most TWO times norm(S_lambda).

A contractive inclusion from EVERY original H^(-r) space with r<=1 to the original H-minus-one base preserves the IDENTICAL ENTIRE original distribution. Exact original raw coefficients and Sobolev norms are retained; no reality, zero mean or physical period-one premise is needed.

The exact source identity B_lambda*(lambda*J-A_q)*D_lambda=I_lambda-S_lambda is PROVED on EVERY l2 vector with the ACTUAL entire original H1/H-minus-one pencil and the ACTUAL full source perturbation matrix. The proof retains the entire absolutely convergent source convolution and the original potential coefficient at EVERY frequency difference. No factorization is supplied as a hypothesis.

The normalized formula D_lambda*(I_lambda-S_lambda)^(-1)*B_lambda solves EVERY original H-minus-one forcing and is LEFT-inverse on EVERY original H1 vector. It proves actual original native resolvent-set membership. The EXISTING actual native resolvent is proved EXACTLY equal to the NEGATIVE of this formula, with its original A_q-lambda*J orientation accounted for.

ONE cutoff BEFORE EVERY complex original H^(-r) potential in EACH specified original Sobolev norm ball, ALL later ORIGINAL positive indices and EVERY point of EACH ENTIRE LITERAL source circle gives native resolvent validity, norm at most TWO for the actual normalized inverse and the exact actual native resolvent formula. This holds for EVERY 0<=r<1, including the ENTIRE source Appendix C.4 range -1<t<-1/2, with r=-t.

The original native half-domain map has EXACTLY the already constructed source-periodic physical L2 image and the SAME continuous physical representative on ALL l2 inputs. The full native base half-map agrees EXACTLY with the original physical L2 half-denominator on EVERY periodic Hilbert input. The source probability Haar normalization, exactly one-half integral on [0,2], is retained.
